##About				
This electric bike tour is the perfect way to experience the beauty and charm of the Montecito and Santa Barbara areas. Whether you're a local looking to explore your own backyard, or a visitor looking to get a taste of California's stunning coastline, this tour is not to be missed!

Throughout the tour, our experienced guide will provide fascinating insights into the history and culture of the area, as well as tips on the best places to eat, shop, and explore. And with our easy-to-use electric bikes, you'll be able to cover a lot of ground without breaking a sweat.
